title: 第19章 消息第20章 苦修
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 因为只要一直坚持下去，哪怕孙冰暂时还不能运转练气之法，速度也远超常人，这样在打斗的时候，就能夺得先机，对战力有着极大的提升。
而且速度远超常人的话，也就意味着别人根本就追不上你，就算你没有对方强，可自己能跑掉，保命再是最主要的，命没了，哪怕拥有再多东西，也是一场空。
一路上静静的体会着自己的脚步，反而对于这《浮光掠影》步法有了更深刻的认识，那些看起来相当古怪的动作，现在竟然让他感觉有些和谐。
尤其是奔走之时，身体内部竟然涌现出一种力道，这让孙冰的身体更加的轻盈，速度也就随之而进行变化了，但当孙冰仔细查看自己肉身的时候，却又没有发现任何异常情况，似乎刚刚涌现出的力道根本就不存在一样。
“没有想到玄级的步法已经如此深奥了，那么地级或者天级，又会是如何呢？”对此，孙冰不由得发出惊叹，同时对于传说中的那些秘籍不由得更加好奇了。
孙冰来的时候足足花了半日光景，才从落云镇赶到横断山脉，但是当他回去的时候，因为有《浮光掠影》的帮助，竟然省下了三分之一的时间，最主要的是，竟然还没有被别人发现，因为在别人的眼中，孙冰与他们一样，都是正常的奔跑罢了。
孙冰本来还以为就算是修炼成功了，也得藏着掖着，不能够被他人，不然一定会引起他人的窥视，但现在既然保密性如此高，那么今后也能大大方方的施展出来了。
就算回来的速度已经显着加快了，但当孙冰赶回落云镇的时候，天色也已经完全黑了下来，这时候若返回孙家的话，时间有点迟了，指不定还会受到什么追问，当即孙冰也懒得返回，随意的弄点吃的，便回到了独属自己的山崖。
此处依旧安静，并没有任何人来过，可孙冰依旧小心翼翼的查探了一番，这才将自己怀中的物品取了出来，现在的他在整个落云镇中应该算是数得上的富豪了。
单单这一本《浮光掠影》就让人垂涎，哪怕是三大家族甚至都没有这种品级的步法，这等珍贵的物品再怎么小心都不为过。
当晚相当安静，继续研究了一下面前的秘籍后，孙冰便也有些疲劳了，毕竟今天连番大战，消耗的精气神着实有些多，继续要好好休息。
所以孙冰就宛若苦修士般的盘坐在自己搭建的棚顶下，木剑横放在双腿上，就此进入了梦乡。
次日一早，孙冰便已经清醒，摸了摸自己的木剑，感觉自己与它的联系似乎更深了，嘴角不由得露出了一丝笑容，这十年间，他可以说是木剑不离身，现在终于有了一定的反馈，隐隐约约建立了一丝联系。
一遍基础剑法演练完毕，孙冰身上并没有任何汗水，反而站在悬崖之上，双眼中泛着一丝迷茫，口中喃喃道：“今天应该又到了领取月俸的时间了吧。”
没有想到时间竟然过的如此快，不知不觉一个月就过去了，但对于孙冰来说，这一个月的时间里，发生了天翻地覆的改变，因为他从原来那个无法修炼的废人，变成了一个淬体境四层的修士。
虽然说孙冰昨天已经发了一笔横财，根本不需要在意一瓶淬体丹，但修炼资源这种东西，根本没有人嫌多，每月一瓶其实根本就不够使用的，当即，他立刻开始动身。
从后山到账房，走过这么一段熟悉的路程，孙冰依旧是感慨万千，尤其是看到了不远处秦管事那宛若皮球般的身体，嘴角更是露出了一丝笑容，可以说，这一次来领取月俸，与以往的心情根本就不一样。
熟练的排在队伍的最后，孙冰又听到了周围传来了密密麻麻的议论声，说实话，对于这样的声音孙冰丝毫不厌恶，甚至也在默默的倾听着。
因为这里人数众多，基本上想要什么消息都能够知晓，孙冰这么些年中，了解神州大地是通过书籍知晓，而知道落云镇中的大小事情，更多的还是这些弟子们的功劳。
无论大小事情，除了那些保密性比较高的事情，这些人都了解的一清二楚，实在是让人钦佩。
突然间，孙冰耳朵一动，听到了让他在意的消息：“话说你们这段时间过的怎么样啊？修为境界提升没有？下个月就要外门大比了，不知道这一次又有什么人会被淘汰。”
“是啊，时间过的真快，反正和我们的关系不大，只要能够保证自己不被淘汰就好了，想那么多干嘛？”另一人马上回答道。
“话不能这么说啊，万一你朋友实力强，通过外门大比进入内门了，你也能沾点光啊。”那人马上反驳道。
不过此刻的孙冰倒是完全的忽略了他两的交谈，自己陷入思索之中，没有想到今年的外门大比又要开始了。
顾名思义，外门大比就是孙家这群外门弟子的试炼，其实外门弟子说起来好听，其实没什么，其实在孙家地位相当低下，甚至可以说是孙家养着的炮灰。
提供给你一本秘籍学习，每个月还有淬体丹发放，那是为了增加你的实力，不然战斗刚刚开始，你就挂了，根本发挥不出炮灰的作用。
可就这外门弟子也是相当受欢迎的，毕竟战斗的时间终究较少，而且还能够受孙家庇护，所以这就要取其精华去其糟粕，每一年都会举行一次外门大比。
其中最前面的三名弟子能够获得丰富的奖励，因为只有这样才能培育出强者，甚至已经被重点观察，今后还有望进入孙家，至于最后的三名则要面临淘汰，孙家虽然家大业大不在乎，却也不能容忍你留在这里吃白饭，这就是外门大比的意义。
至于孙冰，毕竟是族长的义子，所以不可能将其剔除，若不然就会有人说孙家忘恩负义了，所以哪怕没有参加过一次外门大比，待遇依旧存在，只不过以前经常被剥削罢了。
修炼一途便是一个字“争”，曾经的孙冰不过一介凡人，根本就没有资格参加这样的比试，可现在完全不同了，他现有希望去竞争，要知道前三名的奖励哪怕是孙冰发了横财之后，都不由得一阵心动。
“看来是时候奋战外门大比了。”孙冰心中暗暗道，毕竟时间在一个月之后，孙冰从一介凡人到淬体境四层巅峰，也才花费了一个月的时间，再来一个月也不知道会发生多么巨大的变化。
就在孙冰思考如何应对家族大比的时候，队伍不知不觉已经消失了大半，就差一个人便到了孙冰了，抬头一看，便发现前面一个弟子满脸的愤怒，因为柜台上仅仅只有五两银子，而且也没有淬体丹。
很显然这名弟子的月俸也被苛刻了大半，但形势比人强，这只是一个普普通通的弟子，根本就没有人帮他出头，至于孙冰虽然看到了，但对方与他毫无关系，当即也冷眼旁观。
这弟子消失之后便轮到了孙冰，秦管事一改刚才的行事作风，反倒满脸的笑容，甚至连给出的月俸都多了不少，很显然这就是赤裸裸的讨好。
对于秦管事与以前完全不同的做法，孙冰不过嘴角一笑，这就是实力的变化，在这方世界，唯有变强才是正途。
接过自己的月俸，孙冰转身便朝着自己的住所走去，令他惊奇的是，竟然碰到了一个熟人，那就是打劫了他十年之久的孙策，没有想到在另外两个人已经死亡的情况下，这个人竟然还敢跑过来出手。
只不过现在的孙冰可没有什么功夫与对方废话，当即木剑一闪，甩出了一个漂亮的剑花，然后孙策便感觉自己身上火辣辣的疼痛，没有想到就这样已经身受重伤了，只能带着惊恐的目光望着孙冰远去的背影。
对于这样的小人物，孙冰已经完全不在乎了，若不是孙家严令禁止门下弟子不能自相残杀，此刻已经人头落地了。
不过虽然孙冰已经留了对方一命，但却生不如死了，因为他手上的经脉已经完全被挑断了，也就代表着再也不能进行修炼了，哪怕活着，等待的也是浓浓的绝望。
content_en:
Because as long as he persists, even if Sun Bing is not able to use the Qi training method for the time being, his speed will be far faster than ordinary people. In this way, he will be able to gain the upper hand in a fight and greatly improve his combat power.
And if the speed is much higher than that of ordinary people, it means that others cannot catch up with you at all. Even if you are not as strong as the opponent, you can run away. Saving your life is the most important thing. If your life is gone, no matter how many things you have, it is all in vain.
He quietly felt his steps along the way, and gained a deeper understanding of the "Glimpse" footwork. Those seemingly weird movements now made him feel somewhat harmonious.
Especially when he was running, a kind of strength emerged from inside his body, which made Sun Bing's body lighter and his speed changed accordingly. However, when Sun Bing carefully looked at his body, he did not find anything abnormal. It seemed that the strength that had just emerged did not exist at all.
"I didn't expect the footwork of Xuan level to be so profound, what about the Earth level or Heaven level?" Sun Bing couldn't help but marvel at this, and at the same time he couldn't help but become more curious about the legendary secret books.
When Sun Bing came, it took him half a day to get to the Hengduan Mountains from Luoyun Town. But when he went back, with the help of "Glimpse", he actually saved a third of the time. The most important thing was that he was not discovered by others, because in the eyes of others, Sun Bing was just running normally like them.
Sun Bing originally thought that even if he succeeded in cultivation, he would have to hide it from others, otherwise it would definitely attract other people's prying eyes. But now that the confidentiality is so high, he can display it openly in the future.
Even though the speed of his return has been significantly accelerated, when Sun Bing rushed back to Luoyun Town, the sky was already completely dark. If he returned to Sun's house at this time, it would be a bit late, and he might be questioned. Sun Bing did not bother to return immediately, grabbed some food at will, and returned to his own cliff.
The place was still quiet and no one had been here, but Sun Bing still carefully checked it out before taking out the items in his arms. Now he should be considered one of the richest people in the entire Luoyun Town.
This book "Glimpse of Light" alone is coveted. Even the three major families don't even have this level of footwork. No matter how careful you are with such precious items, you can't be too careful.
It was quite quiet that night. After continuing to study the secret book in front of him, Sun Bing became a little tired. After all, the continuous battles today consumed a lot of energy and energy, so he continued to have a good rest.
So Sun Bing sat cross-legged under the roof of the shed he built like an ascetic monk, with the wooden sword placed across his legs, and fell asleep.
Early the next morning, Sun Bing was already awake. He touched his wooden sword and felt that his connection with it seemed to be deeper. He couldn't help but reveal a smile. In the past ten years, he could be said to have kept his wooden sword close to him. Now he finally had some feedback and a vague connection was established.
After finishing the basic swordsmanship drill, Sun Bing didn't sweat at all. Instead, he stood on the cliff, with a trace of confusion in his eyes, and murmured: "Today should be the time to receive monthly salary again."
I didn't expect that time would go by so fast, and one month would pass before I knew it. But for Sun Bing, earth-shaking changes had taken place in this month, because he had changed from the useless person who could not practice to a monk at the fourth level of the Body Tempering Realm.
Although Sun Bing had made a fortune yesterday and didn't need to care about a bottle of Body Tempering Pill, no one had too much cultivation resources. One bottle per month was actually not enough. He immediately started to set off.
After walking such a familiar journey from the back mountain to the accounting room, Sun Bing was still full of emotions, especially when he saw Manager Qin's ball-like body not far away, and a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth. It can be said that this time when he came to receive his monthly salary, his mood was completely different from the past.
Skillfully standing at the end of the queue, Sun Bing heard dense discussions coming from around him again. To be honest, Sun Bing was not disgusted by such sounds at all, and was even listening silently.
Because there are so many people here, you can basically know any news you want. Over the years, Sun Bing has learned about the land of China through books, and knowing the big and small things in Luoyun Town is more due to the contribution of these disciples.
No matter how big or small, except for those matters that are relatively confidential, these people understand everything clearly, which is really admirable.
Suddenly, Sun Bing's ears twitched and he heard news that concerned him: "How are you doing during this time? Have your cultivation levels improved? The outer sect competition will be held next month. I don't know who will be eliminated this time."
"Yes, time flies so fast. It has nothing to do with us anyway. As long as we can ensure that we are not eliminated, why do we think so much?" Another person immediately replied.
"You can't say that. If your friend is strong and enters the inner gate through the outer gate competition, you can also get some glory." The man immediately retorted.
However, at this moment, Sun Bing completely ignored the conversation between the two of them and was lost in thought. He did not expect that this year's outer sect competition would start again.
As the name suggests, the Outer Sect Competition is a test for the Sun family's outer disciples. In fact, the outer disciples may sound nice, but in fact they are nothing. In fact, their status in the Sun family is quite low, and they can even be said to be cannon fodder raised by the Sun family.
We will provide you with a secret book to study and distribute body tempering pills every month. This is to increase your strength. Otherwise, you will die as soon as the battle begins and you will not be able to play the role of cannon fodder at all.
But these outer sect disciples are also quite popular. After all, they have less time to fight, and they can also be protected by the Sun family. Therefore, it is necessary to take the best and discard the dross. An outer sect competition is held every year.
The top three disciples among them can get rich rewards, because only in this way can strong people be cultivated. They have even been under special observation and are expected to enter the Sun family in the future. As for the last three disciples, they will face elimination. Although the Sun family has a big business and doesn't care about it, it can't tolerate you staying here to eat for nothing. This is the meaning of the outer sect competition.
As for Sun Bing, after all, he is the adopted son of the clan leader, so it is impossible to exclude him. Otherwise, some people will say that the Sun family is ungrateful. Therefore, even if he has not participated in an outer sect competition, the treatment is still there, but he was often exploited in the past.
The journey of cultivation is all about "competition". In the past, Sun Bing was just a mortal and was not qualified to participate in such a competition. But now it is completely different. He now hopes to compete. Knowing that the rewards for the top three are even after Sun Bing made a windfall, he couldn't help but feel excited.
"Looks like it's time to fight for the outer sect competition." Sun Bing thought secretly in his heart. After all, it took only one month for Sun Bing to go from a mortal to the peak of the fourth level of the Body Tempering Realm. In another month, there is no telling what huge changes will happen.
Just when Sun Bing was thinking about how to deal with the family competition, most of the team had disappeared unknowingly, and only one person was missing. Sun Bing looked up and saw that the face of the disciple in front was full of anger, because there was only five taels of silver on the counter, and there was no body tempering pill.
It was obvious that most of this disciple's monthly salary had been harshed, but the situation was stronger than others. This was just an ordinary disciple, and no one helped him stand up. As for Sun Bing, although he saw it, the other party had nothing to do with him, and he immediately looked on with cold eyes.
After the disciple disappeared, it was Sun Bing's turn. Manager Qin changed his behavior and smiled all over his face. He even gave him a much higher monthly salary. It was obvious that this was a naked attempt to please.
Regarding Manager Qin's completely different approach from before, Sun Bing just smiled. This is a change in strength. In this world, the only way is to become stronger.
After receiving his salary, Sun Bing turned around and walked towards his residence. To his surprise, he met an acquaintance, Sun Ce, who had robbed him for ten years. He did not expect that this person would dare to come over and take action when the other two people were already dead.
But now Sun Bing didn't have much time to talk nonsense with the opponent. He immediately flashed his wooden sword and threw out a beautiful sword flower. Then Sun Ce felt the burning pain in his body. He didn't expect that he was seriously injured. He could only look at Sun Bing's retreating back with horrified eyes.
Sun Bing didn't care about such a little person at all. If it weren't for the Sun family's strict prohibition on killing each other, all of his disciples would be dead right now.
However, although Sun Bing had spared the other party's life, he was still worse off than dead, because the meridians in his hand had been completely severed, which meant that he could no longer practice. Even if he was alive, what he was waiting for was deep despair.
